description: Yield farming opportunities on Base: liquidity pools, concentrated liquidity (Aerodrome Slipstream) and auto-compounding vaults, ranked risk-adjusted, with quoted APY split into fees and token rewards, the sustainable APY once incentives fade, TVL, a risk score, and realized APY where measured. Useful for picking farms worth their risk. Ids work with every other route. 404 for unknown paths and 400 for invalid arguments, before any payment; 503 while data refreshes; charged only for a 200. Price: $0.01 USDC on Base (x402), charged only for a successful answer.

asset.description: Token symbol, e.g. USDC or WETH.

realized_only.description: Only opportunities with a realized on-chain APY.

risk_max.description: Maximum risk score (0-100, lower is lower modelled risk).

sort.description: Order: risk_adjusted (default) ranks by opportunity score; realized_apy by the 30-day realized APY; sustainable_apy by the APY expected once incentives fade.

type.description: lp, stable_lp (stablecoin pairs), concentrated (concentrated liquidity) or vault (auto-compounding vaults).

name: get_yield_farming
